messages:
Ari (Sales Eng): Heads-up 4h Nebulon Pay wants a short POC: stream transaction events into our SDK, run on-the-fly enrichment via function calls, and enforce strict schema validation before commit. CTO asked for auditability and an easy artifact for procurement. Any immediate blockers? @Noor @Ben
Noor (Solutions): We can do streaming + tool/function calls. Recommend using schema enforcement on the stream request; validation runs server-side and we return a structured error object with JSON path on failures. Works with tool calls too (tool responses get fed back into the session).
Ari (Sales Eng): Nice. Can you paste a tiny example we can hand to their infra team? They use Node + k8s sidecars.
Noor (Solutions): Tiny TS example below showing streaming + function call + strict schema:
```ts
import { StreamClient } from 'redwood-sdk'
const client = new StreamClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const schema = { type: 'object', properties: { txId: { type: 'string' }, amt: { type: 'number' } }, required: ['txId','amt'] }
const s = client.stream({ model: 'tx-stream-v2', schema })
await s.send({ txId: 't-1001', amt: 42.5 })
for await (const ev of s.receive()) {
  if (ev.type === 'structured_output') handle(ev.json)
  if (ev.type === 'tool_call') {
    // call external enrichment, then respond
    const out = await callEnrich(ev.tool, ev.args)
    await s.respondTool(ev.callId, out)
  }
}
```
Noor (Solutions): Note: respondTool returns the tool output into the same stream so the model can consume the enrichment immediately.
Ben (Presales): For the POC path: hosted demo is fastest. If they insist on Dedicated we need ~4 weeks lead time. Ballpark for a 2-week hosted POC (moderate QPS, streaming active) is $2.5k		$6k depending on model and retention.
Ari (Sales Eng): Procurement will want a security answers sheet and a note on schema mismatch behavior. Marina, can Security prep?
Marina (Security): Yep. Quick bullets Ill include in the pack:
- Regions: us-west-2, eu-central-1 available for hosted POCs
- Encryption: TLS in transit + customer KMS for at-rest keys
- Access: token scopes, short-lived creds, SSO/SAML for Console
- Audit: per-request trace IDs, exportable audit logs (S3/streaming)
- Compliance: SOC2 contact and recent pen-test summary on request
Marina (Security): On schema mismatch: default = reject and return a structured error with failing path. We offer an opt-in lenient mode that attaches warnings and partial payloads, but not recommended for financial ledgers.
Ari (Sales Eng): Good. Also they asked about retention and redaction: can we redact PII in transit or mask fields?
Noor (Solutions): We support field-level redaction rules in the ingest pipeline (masking/omit). You can also configure auto-kv-cache to reduce repeated tokenization costs for hot keys.
Ben (Presales): Ops note: recommend provisioning reserved burst capacity during initial backfill and enable batching for throughput. That keeps latency bounded and lowers token consumption.
Ari (Sales Eng): I'll ask them for QPS histogram and send the security XLSX tomorrow. Can we get a short "what to expect" doc for their infra team?
Noor (Solutions): I'll draft a 1-page runbook: SDK snippets (node/py), schema example, tool-call wiring, and a checklist for k8s sidecar timeouts and retry semantics.
Marina (Security): I'll attach the one-pager answers and SOC2 contact once they send the questionnaire.
infra-bot: Demo environment provisioned: demo.redwood.ai/nebulon-pay-07 	 credentials sent to Ari via DM.
Ari (Sales Eng): Received. Scheduling a 30m technical kickoff for tomorrow 9am PT. Agenda: walkthrough SDK example, schema validation demo, and security Q&A. Thanks all :thumbsup:
